title: 车迟国三场比试
subtitle: 真正的本领是一起解决问题
origin: 《西游记》第四十四至四十六回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 比试不是为了让别人难堪，而是发现更好的办法；肯观察、会分工、愿合作，大家就能一起赢。
moral.en: A contest should help us discover better ways, not embarrass others. Observation, shared roles, and cooperation let everyone win together.

pages.zh: 师徒来到车迟国。国王正在为干旱发愁，听说远方来的客人很会解决难题，便请他们到宫苑商量办法。
pages.en: The travelers reached the Kingdom of Chechi. Worried about a drought, the king invited the famous problem-solvers to the palace garden.

pages.en: Three royal teachers—Tiger Strength, Deer Strength, and Antelope Strength—suggested three contests: guide rain to the fields, make a dry branch bloom, and move grain together.

pages.en: The king shared the grain with the people, and the three teachers thanked the travelers. As the group left Chechi, they heard a great river ahead and saw festival lotus lanterns on the water.
